system.description:
OPDQ, during a Combat Encounter only: roll a CR 1 Heart Check. On a success each ally adds +1 Skill Die to Attack Action rolls until the encounter ends, or +1 Talent Die instead if you rolled 3 or more successes.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.53
system.summary: OPDQ, during a Combat Encounter only: roll a CR 1 Heart Check. On a success each ally adds +1 Skill Die to Attack Action rolls until the encounter ends, or +1 Talent Die instead if you rolled 3 or more successes.

automation.label: Combat Encounters only
automation.onSuccess: Each ally adds +1 Skill Die to Attack Action rolls until the Combat Encounter ends (+1 Talent Die instead with 3+ successes).

automation.note: On a success, each ally adds the bonus die themselves: +1 Skill Die (or +1 Talent Die if you rolled 3+ successes) on their Attack Action rolls until the encounter ends.
